children: Brazil's public debt rose nearly 1% in September, driven largely by interest costs, Treasury data showed on Thursday, as interest expenses continued to drive debt accumulation.
Brazil's public debt increased 0.97% from August, to 9.383 trillion reais ($1.76 trillion), with interest expenses totaling 89.5 billion reais in the month
Debt issuance reached 189.4 billion reais, but was almost entirely offset by redemptions totaling 188.7 billion reais over the same period
Interest costs also dominated the year-to-date result, amounting to 784.4 billion reais, while net debt redemptions totaled 36.5 billion reais
The Treasury expects the total federal public debt stock to end 2026 between 9.7 trillion and 10.3 trillion reais

The Treasury said buybacks of government bonds totaled 31.6 billion reais ($5.9 billion) over Monday and Tuesday after the re-election of leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on Sunday triggered a market selloff
The buybacks were aimed at "contributing to the proper functioning of the market amid the repricing of assets and the adjustment of positions," the Treasury added
